generation_prompt_reference: Design an original production-quality outline SVG icon family sample for SPORTZZ, a premium sports streaming and technology brand. Exactly five independent icons in a single horizontal row separated with generous whitespace: home, search, settings gear, activity heartbeat, football soccer ball. Each icon on a precise 24x24 grid, consistent 1.75px black stroke, rounded caps and joins, transparent background, no fills except stroke geometry, balanced optical margins. Professional thin outline quality but completely original independent geometry; do not copy Font Awesome paths. Simple recognizable silhouettes, elegant negative space. Must work at 16,20,24,32 px. No letters, labels, typography, logo, colors, gradients, shadows, raster images or decorative frames. This SVG is a reference master only; five icons will be separated and normalized to currentColor SVG paths for production.
reference_note: Magnific sample used for direction; every production icon reconstructed locally as editable paths.
